tools.name: Tacotron 2
tools.description: The Tacotron 2 model generates mel spectrograms from input text using an encoder-decoder architecture, and it is designed for generating natural-sounding speech from raw transcripts without any additional prosody information. This implementation uses Dropout instead of Zoneout to regularize the LSTM layers. The WaveGlow model (also available via torch.hub) is a flow-based model that consumes the mel spectrograms to generate speech.
